---
applyTo: "skills/**/*.md"
---

# Skill Cross-File Completeness Review

## Purpose

When `skills/` changes, verify that dependent files are updated too. This layer catches omissions that path-scoped `plugins/`, `tests/`, etc. instructions miss when those files are absent. Treat incomplete renames as high-confidence visible comments.

## Plugin manifests + marketplace

When a `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is added, renamed, OR removed, the diff MUST include the matching plugin manifest changes per this routing table (each plugin entry refers to that plugin's `.github/plugin/plugin.json`):

| Skill suffix / shape | Required plugin(s) |
|---|---|
| `-authoring-cli` | `fabric-authoring` + `fabric-skills` |
| `-consumption-cli` | `fabric-consumption` + `fabric-skills` |
| `-operations-cli` | `fabric-operations` + `fabric-skills` |
| `e2e-*` (cross-workload) | `fabric-skills` (plus axis plugin if applicable) |
| Migration / project-shaped (`*-migration`) | `fabric-skills` only |

Plus both regenerated marketplace files: `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` and `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. The plugin-to-skills mapping is read directly from each `plugins/<name>/.github/plugin/plugin.json` at runtime via `build/plugin_index.py` -- no separate index file.

- ADD: manifests add the new entry.
- RENAME: manifests update the old path to the new path.
- REMOVE: manifests remove the entry.

Marketplace files are regenerated by `python build/build_plugins.py` after any manifest change. CI runs `--check` and fails on drift. Flag which required file is missing. Forgetting `fabric-skills` (union plugin) is the most common mistake.

For RENAME, also flag any old skill name still present in changed skill docs (frontmatter, heading, CRITICAL NOTES, trigger/disambiguation text, links).

## Changelog fragment and README

A `.changeset/PR<number>-<slug>.md` fragment MUST exist in the PR diff whenever this PR adds, renames, removes, or materially expands `skills/<name>/SKILL.md`. The fragment uses markdown subsections (`### Added` / `### Changed` / `### Removed` / `### Fixed`) and must name the skill explicitly. See `.changeset/README.md`.

**Do NOT flag PRs for missing direct `CHANGELOG.md` edits.** It is auto-populated from fragments at release time; direct edits cause conflicts.

`README.md` skill-catalog table MUST be updated when a skill is added, renamed, or removed (catalog description stale = flag).

Flag any missing.

## Compatibility files

When a `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is added, renamed, OR removed, ALL FOUR compatibility files MUST be in the diff:

- `compatibility/CLAUDE.md`
- `compatibility/AGENTS.md`
- `compatibility/.cursorrules`
- `compatibility/.windsurfrules`

For ADD: reference added. For RENAME: reference renamed. For REMOVE: reference removed from all four. Partial updates cause drift across editor / CLI integrations.

## Eval plan + routing tests

When a skill is added, or its triggers materially change:

- `tests/full-eval-tests/plan/03-individual-skills/eval-<name>.md` MUST be present with at least 5 cases.
- `tests/test_routing.py` MUST include per-skill prompt class / constants for the trigger surface.
- `tests/evals/<name>/eval.yaml` MUST exist; legacy `tests/tests.json` smoke is break-glass only.

For brand-new skills, the PR description should mention a no-skill baseline comparison proving the skill adds value -- a short bullet or prose note (renames exempt; no formal section required).

## Coverage policy

CI (`coverage_enforcement.py`) already enforces non-empty `reason` fields and detects untracked / stale allow-missing debt. Do NOT re-flag those. Flag only:

- PR-body claims of coverage exemption that are not actually reflected in `.github/coverage-policy.yml`.
- Vacuous `reason` strings (non-empty but uninformative, e.g. "TBD", "todo", "needs work").

## Ownership manifest

CI (`test_skill_ownership_manifest.py`) already enforces missing, extra, and stale ownership entries. Do NOT re-flag those.
